Container.Name: Arrmada
Container.Overview:
Arrmada finds, downloads and organises movies, series, books and audiobooks in one app, with requests for your household, subtitles, Convert and Plex watch insights.
This template runs the app only. Use your own qBittorrent (and FlareSolverr if your trackers need it) and add them in Settings, Connections. Map your media share to /storage here and in qBittorrent, at the same path, so imports hardlink instead of copying.
On first start, open the web UI, create the admin account, and pick each library folder and the Downloads folder under /storage. Never put media in /data: that's the database.
Container.Requires: A download client (qBittorrent) you run yourself, with your media share mounted at /storage in it too.

Config.Name: Audiobook server port
Config.Description: For listening apps such as Lissen. Off until you switch it on in the app; 13379 stays clear of an Audiobookshelf on 13378.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: The database, its backups and settings. Keep it in appdata. Never put media here.

Config.Name: Media and downloads
Config.Description: The share that holds your libraries and your downloads (for example /mnt/user/data). One share for both, so imports can hardlink. Each library folder is picked inside it in the app.

Config.Name: Transcode folder
Config.Description: Optional. Scratch space for Convert on a fast cache pool, not the array (for example /mnt/cache/transcode).

Config.Name: GPU
Config.Description: Optional. Intel or AMD graphics for Convert and Whisper subtitles. Leave empty without a GPU.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: The user Arrmada runs as. 99 is Unraid's nobody.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: The group Arrmada runs as. 100 is Unraid's users.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Your timezone, for schedules such as the Convert window (e.g. Australia/Sydney).

Config.Name: Audiobook server host port
Config.Description: The same number as the audiobook server port above, so the app shows people the right address.

Config.Name: FlareSolverr URL
Config.Description: Optional. Your FlareSolverr (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8191), for trackers behind Cloudflare. Can also be set in the app.
